options.label: The Precision Manifest
options.lineage: Indian railway manifest & public sector accounting roster
options.thesis: High-density precision accounting with tabular paisa clarity and live split-flap allowance flips.
options.viewport: Mobile PWA viewport: top status header with live unencumbered cash ₹12,450.00, dynamic daily allowance ₹415/day, quick UPI SMS parser pill, and dense transaction log.
options.risk: Utilitarian density demands strict typographic discipline to avoid looking bureaucratic.
raised: Split-flap concourse: kinetic digit flip transitions on daily allowance & live balance
Midnight transit diagram: vibrant jewel category accents on deep midnight ground

options.label: The Campus Passbook
options.thesis: Warm tactile ledger sheets with crisp ruled rows for hostel rent, tapri chai, and mess dues.
options.viewport: Clean paper-toned mobile view: daily allowance card framed like a student coupon, ledger transaction feed, and tapri quick-presets.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on; feels light and nostalgic rather than high-octane fintech.

options.label: Concourse Split-Flap
options.thesis: The financial state as a live departure board: ticker cells, amber alerts, and rhythmic flip updates.
options.viewport: High-contrast ticker board showing daily spending burn, countdown to stipend, and time-stamped expense tiles.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with live allowance calculation and fast expense feeds; gives visceral physical weight to numbers.
options.risk: Mechanical flip aesthetic can feel overly retro if not balanced with modern mobile touch ergonomics.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.case: Fuses poorly: line-routing geometry overcomplicates daily financial entry.
options.kept: Vivid category color discipline against midnight blue.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder & Plate
options.case: Fuses poorly: encyclopedic layout too heavy for instant UPI expense entry.
options.kept: Compact shoulder margins for status badges and dates.

canonCard.label: Fintech Dark Cards
canonCard.thesis: Modern mobile banking standard: dark card surfaces, pill chips, and neon accents.
canonCard.viewport: Standard card-based banking dashboard with quick action pills and balance hero.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and functional, but visually generic across contemporary fintech apps.
